text: You're looking for a sweet treat that's low in sugar, and I think I have just the thing for you. The Chocolate Cherry Chewies recipe is a great option because it uses unsweetened cocoa and dried tart cherries to add natural sweetness, rather than relying on refined sugars. Plus, it's made with low-fat sweetened condensed milk, which helps keep the sugar content in check. The best part? It's ready in under 35 minutes, so you can satisfy your sweet tooth without breaking your health goals.
